text.tspan: (d) The gate. The best merge decodes left to right and keeps its own token where it is confident (≥); where it is unsure (<) the over merge's token is written instead.
At = 0.8 about 24% of the tokens are handed over and about 3% actually change — enough to inherit the precision without losing the finish rate.

text.style: font: 12.5px 'Times New Roman', 'STIXGeneral', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Over distillation: the over-merged model knows more per token but cannot finish — borrow its tokens only where the best merge is unsure
